subtitle: SSS and SAS proofs, ASA/AAS/HL proofs, and CPCTC equations

problems.desc: Guided SSS proof: isosceles triangle ABC with D the midpoint of BC. Fill the two missing reasons - AD = AD is the Reflexive Property of Congruence, and the triangles are congruent by SSS. Open reasoning - human review.

SAS proof with intersecting segments: E is the midpoint of both AC and BD. Statements are supplied; the student writes all four reasons (definition of midpoint twice, vertical angles congruent, SAS). Open reasoning - human review.

SAS proof with an angle bisector: PQ = PR and PS bisects angle QPR; prove triangle PQS = triangle PRS. Student supplies the missing statements AND reasons, including the reflexive side PS. Open reasoning - human review.

ASA proof with parallel lines: AB parallel to CD, E the midpoint of AC, B-E-D collinear; prove triangle ABE = triangle CDE using alternate interior angles, the midpoint, and vertical angles. Open reasoning - human review.

AAS proof, reasons supplied and statements blank: triangles WXZ and YZX share side XZ, angle W = angle Y and angle WXZ = angle YZX; the student writes the statement column. Open reasoning - human review.
AAS proof from an angle bisector: LN bisects angle KLM and angle K = angle M; prove triangle KLN = triangle MLN. Student writes the whole two-column proof. Open reasoning - human review.
HL proof: right angles at A and C, AB = CB, shared hypotenuse BD; prove triangle ABD = triangle CBD by HL, and explain why SSA is not a general test but HL is. Open reasoning - human review.

Synthesis with overlapping triangles: S on PQ and T on PR with PS = PT and PQ = PR; prove triangle PQT = triangle PRS by SAS using the shared angle P, then state the CPCTC conclusion QT = RS. Open reasoning - human review.
